feat(camellia): migrate system config pages

Summary:
- add shared request and local-storage helpers for camellia system config
- migrate system app, endpoint, oss, and settings routes into React Router
- wire the new pages into console navigation and restore settings child entry

Rationale:
- DAM-20 requires a basic usable migration of the legacy woodii system
  configuration surface into camellia
- keeping the routes on the shared api-client and ui scaffolds preserves one
  request baseline and one form/list baseline for later migrations

Tests:
- pnpm run check:camellia
- curl local build routes for /system/app /system/endpoint /system/oss
  /system/settings /system/settings/server
